criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: User seeks broad, foundational knowledge or general understanding about COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 News & Updates
categories.definition: User requests current, time-sensitive information, daily reports, or news from specific regions or sources regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Symptoms & Diagnosis
categories.definition: User asks about symptoms, how to identify the disease, or when to be concerned about potential infection.

categories.name: COVID-19 Transmission
categories.definition: User inquires about how the virus spreads, its viability on surfaces, or specific modes of transmission.

categories.name: COVID-19 Prevention & Safety Measures
categories.definition: User asks about actions to take to prevent infection, including hygiene, personal protective equipment, and social distancing.

categories.name: COVID-19 Treatment & Recovery
categories.definition: User seeks information on available treatments, self-care options, or the recovery process for COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Vaccines
categories.definition: User asks about the development, approval, or effectiveness of vaccines for COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Myths & Misinformation
categories.definition: User seeks to verify or debunk common myths, hoaxes, or misconceptions about COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Statistics & Data
categories.definition: User requests numerical data, case counts, death rates, testing figures, or other statistical information related to COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Travel & Location Risk
categories.definition: User inquires about the safety of travel, identifies high-risk areas, or asks about local restrictions related to COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 & Animals/Pets
categories.definition: User asks about the virus's impact on animals, transmission from or to pets, or pet care during the pandemic.

categories.name: Donation & Support for COVID-19 Efforts
categories.definition: User expresses intent to offer or find ways to donate money, supplies, or support to individuals or organizations affected by COVID-19.

categories.name: Social Sharing
categories.definition: User expresses intent to share information, articles, or the bot service with others.
